parts.note: a reserve or stock of goods is a store
a goalie is the goalkeeper, or keeper

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper who also stands in as the substitute goalkeeper for the local team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reserve goalie' reads as a substitute keeper, but 'reserve' is a noun giving the first piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopkeeper who keeps a shop is a retailer, selling goods directly to the public.

explanation.surface: A note about where the line of waiting people stops.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear part of anything is its end; and a pigtail or a line of people waiting is also called by this word.

indicators.note: announced means spoken out, so the clue word is heard rather than written

parts.note: to transport someone is to give them a ride

explanation.surface: A public announcement about buses and trains heading to a seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: RYDE is a seaside resort on the Isle of Wight, off England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Ryde is a seaside holiday town, a classic English holiday destination.

clue.text: Modern surgery to which the eye is put

definitions.text: to which the eye is put

explanation.surface: A medical description that turns into a peeping-tom image.
explanation.definitionFit: Minimally invasive operations are called by this name; and a nosy person puts an eye to the lock's opening to spy through a door.

indicators.note: internally means the letters come from inside the clue word suffering

explanation.surface: A history note about Ireland's past hardships.
explanation.walkthrough: ERIN is an old poetic name for Ireland, hence 'once'.
explanation.definitionFit: Erin is the old, poetic name for Ireland, used in songs and verse.

clue.text: These people glide over snow in some distress

indicators.note: in means the skiing word sits inside the shuffled letters
distress means the letters of some are thrown into disorder

parts.note: to glide over snow is to ski

explanation.surface: People skiing across the snow while in some difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distress' scrambles SOME into E..MOS, and 'in' places SKI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The term once used for the Arctic peoples of Greenland, Canada and Alaska, who travel across snowfields.

clue.text: Breathes out suffering near that place

indicators.note: suffering indicates the letters of Breathes out are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: Someone in pain exhaling heavily somewhere close by.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means roughly at or close to the location mentioned, an approximate position.

clue.text: Twinkling collection, not from the top drawer

parts.note: in a twinkling means in a moment, or a second
a class is a group or collection of things of one kind

explanation.surface: A sparkling set of jewels that is not of the finest quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top drawer' is a British idiom for upper-class or best quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inferior or not of the best grade is not top-drawer quality.

clue.text: Device to dispense single playing-card in Oxford, for example

explanation.surface: A card-dealing gadget at a casino in the university city.
explanation.definitionFit: Casino dealers draw cards one at a time from a box of this name; and an Oxford is a style of laced footwear.

clue.text: Game in which top of the table men are put under pressure, going for cup

definitions.text: Game in which top of the table men are put under pressure, going for cup

parts.words: Game in which top of the table men are put under pressure, going for cup
parts.note: reads like league leaders in a football cup run, but describes small discs on a tabletop pressed down so they flip into a pot

explanation.surface: The league leaders feel the strain as they chase a cup trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top of the table' sounds like a league position, but means the surface of a table; the 'men' are counters pressed by a larger disc so they jump into a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole clue describes a parlour game of flicking small discs into a pot.

indicators.note: in signals that the letters are concealed inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Feeling lively thanks to living in healthy surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio is vigour or verve, borrowed from Italian, a synonym for spirited energy.

parts.note: entire means whole
a crowd is a large number of people

explanation.surface: Asking whether a single person might be counted among a whole crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One, perhaps' is a definition by example: 1 is an integer.
explanation.definitionFit: An integer such as 1 is a number with no fractional part.

clue.text: One of two planned tea interval

indicators.note: planned suggests the letters of tea interval are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: An office worker choosing between two scheduled tea breaks.
explanation.definitionFit: A choice between two possibilities offers an option, either of which may be taken.

explanation.surface: Buying a satchel for a child starting at a state secondary school.
explanation.walkthrough: A comprehensive is a British state school that takes pupils of every ability, so it would 'hold all'.
explanation.definitionFit: A large travelling bag takes everything; and a comprehensive school admits every child regardless of ability.

indicators.note: absorbing means one piece takes another into its middle

parts.note: LA is the abbreviation for the city of Los Angeles, plus the possessive S
go means energy or drive

explanation.surface: A metropolis soaking up power from the grid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital city' looks like the definition, but 'city's' gives LA'S; Lagos was Nigeria's capital until 1991.
explanation.definitionFit: Lagos was long the seat of Nigerian government, a former national capital.

clue.text: Depressed country that has no peaks

parts.note: depressed means low, in mood or in height
a country is a land

explanation.surface: A gloomy nation with no mountains to lift its spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Low-lying flat terrain without hills or mountains is described with this adjective.

indicators.note: over means the word for party is turned around and read the other way

parts.note: a revel is a lively party

explanation.surface: A way of turning the political party round.
explanation.definitionFit: A bar that pivots to shift a load or rotate a mechanism is a tool for turning.

clue.text: Where showy fiddler's act must end?

definitions.text: Where showy fiddler's act must end?

parts.words: Where showy fiddler's act must end?
parts.note: plays on the musical Fiddler on the Roof: a performer up there must stop at the edge of the rooftop

explanation.surface: Asking when a flamboyant violinist's performance has to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: The fiddler is the one on the roof, from the musical title; his act ends where the roof's edge overhangs the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: The overhanging lower edge of a roof marks where a rooftop performance runs out of space.

explanation.surface: Someone who was deceptive while singing a song from Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissembled means told falsehoods; and a Lied is a German art song, an air in the musical sense.

parts.note: read as brother plus hood, the hooded garment worn by a friar

explanation.surface: A single word asking about fraternity.
explanation.walkthrough: Split it as 'brother hood': a monk's or friar's hood.
explanation.definitionFit: A monk's hooded robe is literally a hood for a brother of a religious order.

explanation.surface: Someone worn out after a long session with a power drill.
explanation.definitionFit: Made weary means wearied by tedium; and having drilled means having made a hole through something.

parts.note: leagues are associations or unions

explanation.surface: Tennis foot-fault calls in British sporting leagues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foot-faults' suggests tennis serving errors, but means defects of the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Painful swellings at the base of the big toe are physical defects of the feet.

clue.text: Disastrous collapse of girl coming out with lace undone

parts.note: a deb, or debutante, is a girl making her entry into society

indicators.note: undone means the letters of lace come apart and are retied differently

explanation.surface: A society girl's grand entrance ruined when her lace dress comes apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'undone' rearranges LACE into ACLE; 'coming out' is a debutante's formal entry into high society.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco or humiliating failure is a disastrous collapse.

indicators.note: about means the letters of Nun slop are moved around

explanation.surface: A nun puzzled about some spilt slop.
explanation.walkthrough: The word is mostly a verb, but here it is the noun meaning bafflement.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of bewilderment, where one is baffled and unable to respond, is perplexity.

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: being broken means the letters of slate are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone recounting the story of a smashed roof tile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being broken' rearranges SLATE into LATES.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount or narrate a story is to tell it.

explanation.surface: A naval officer dies aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' means on a chessboard, not on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchant-navy officer below the captain holds this rank; and checkmate ends a chess game, the king's death on the board.

parts.note: a copper is a penny coin, abbreviated P
a lea is a meadow or field

explanation.surface: A heartfelt appeal from the Dickens hero David Copperfield.
explanation.walkthrough: Copperfield, the Dickens hero, splits into a copper coin (P, a British penny) and a field (LEA).
explanation.definitionFit: An earnest request or appeal for help is an entreaty.

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means the word for weapons is read from bottom to top

parts.note: guns are weapons

explanation.surface: Feeling at ease after putting away the weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosy and warm, as in a snug room, is comfortable.

clue.text: Leading feature of church leaders at home

parts.note: the leading letters of church give CH, also the usual abbreviation
in means at home

explanation.surface: Church elders shown relaxing at home.
explanation.walkthrough: A jutting jaw is the part of the face that leads.
explanation.definitionFit: The lower jaw projects foremost from the face, a prominent facial feature.

clue.text: A chance lost, in a storm, to see these old fish

indicators.note: in a storm means the letters of A chance lost are tossed about wildly

explanation.surface: A fishing trip abandoned when a storm blows up.
explanation.walkthrough: These fish were thought extinct for millions of years until one was caught in 1938.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient lobe-finned species known as living fossils are very old fish.

clue.text: Sin of ambassador with nothing to lose?

indicators.note: to lose means a piece is dropped from the word for ambassador

parts.note: an envoy is an ambassador
O is the zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A diplomat who feels he has nothing to lose by sinning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to lose' removes O from ENVOY.
explanation.definitionFit: Covetousness is one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: English leader to declare deputy for property manager

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of English

parts.note: to state is to declare
an agent acts as a deputy on someone's behalf

explanation.surface: An English leader nominates a stand-in to look after their estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sells or lets houses on behalf of owners manages property.
